title: llama.cpp (LLM)
description: A model served by llama.cpp's llama-server, on this machine or your network, through gohort's client with its thinking switches.
setup_notes: Start llama-server with the model (llama-server -m model.gguf --jinja). gohort provides one, named llamacpp and listed as llama.cpp; another, at another address, is added from here. Choose it under Admin > LLMs > Worker LLM (or Lead LLM), where its address is set and the tier names its model; Test connection there says what is at the address and makes one short real chat. Its parallel requests are capped under Local Model Scheduler.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; the LLM settings list it by this name.

config.name: base_url
config.label: Server address
config.detail: On this machine or its network. Its default is the server's own; a server elsewhere needs its address.

config.name: api_key
config.label: API key
config.help: Only for a server started with --api-key; blank sends none.
